title: Associate – 100 Posts
qualification: Graduation in Civil Engineering or an equivalent discipline from IITs, NITs, or other institutions ranked within the top 100 in the Engineering category of the NIRF Rankings for the year of graduation, or the preceding year in case the candidate is completing their graduation
salary: The remuneration to be paid to the Associate(s), in the form of consultancy fees, shall be approved by the Competent Authority. || The remuneration (consultancy fee) is inclusive of all applicable taxes, and no other facility or allowance is admissible, except that Associates deployed in any Regional Office (RO), Project Monitoring Unit (PMU), or Site Office (SO) located in the Andaman & Nicobar Islands shall be entitled to aLocation Allowance at the rate of 20%of the prescribed consultancy fee, payable for the period of actual deployment, subject to NHIDCL’s terms and conditions. || Anannual enhancement of 5%in the consultancy fee shall be allowed. || Monthly remuneration will be paid within 7 days after completion of the month, subject to periodic completion of work certified by the Controlling Officer. || Income tax or any other applicable tax will be deducted at source as per prevailing rules, for which NHIDCL will issue TDS certificates. Individual consultants are liable to pay Goods and Services Tax (GST), as applicable. NHIDCL undertakes no liability for taxes or other contributions payable by the Associates on payments made under the contract.
age_limit: The upper age limit for the Associate post is 30 years , as on the date of issue of the Advertisement (Hiring Notice).
application_fee: The Hiring Notice does not specify any application fee for the Associate (SSGS) post; candidates should refer to the NHIDCL Resource Pool Portal for confirmation at the time of application.
selection_process: The Hiring Notice directs eligible candidates to apply through the NHIDCL Resource Pool Portal; the notice does not detail a separate written test, and selection proceeds through NHIDCL shortlisting candidates from the Eligible Pool of Applicants for interview, assessment, or other stages, as decided by the Competent Authority based on vacancy availability and operational requirements. || For the purpose of this Hiring Notice, the "Eligible Pool of Applicants" means candidates whose applications/profiles for the relevant position are available in the NHIDCL Resource Pool Portal and who satisfy the prescribed educational qualifications, domicile requirements, age criteria, and other eligibility conditions applicable to the position. || Candidates who applied for the same position under Hiring Notice No. 05/2025, and whose applications are available in the Resource Pool Portal, need not apply again. Further, candidates who were shortlisted and called for interview pursuant to Hiring Notice No. 05/2025 but were not selected shall also remain eligible for consideration and need not submit a fresh application, subject to their continued inclusion in the Eligible Pool of Applicants and fulfilment of the eligibility conditions prescribed in this Recruitment Notice. || NHIDCL may, at its discretion and subject to availability of vacancies, operational requirements, and approval of the Competent Authority, consider, shortlist, and call candidates from the Eligible Pool of Applicants for interview, assessment, or any other stage of selection for present or future requirements under the Scheme – either pursuant to a Recruitment Notice or without issuance of a separate public advertisement, where deemed appropriate. || Registration in the Resource Pool Portal or inclusion in the Eligible Pool of Applicants doesnotconfer any right to shortlisting, interview, engagement, or appointment.
